args.prompt: The creature is cute, silly and friendly, never scary, in the same chunky pixel style and outline as the cat-unicorn reference sheet. A cute PAJAMA OWL: a round chubby purple-lavender owl wearing a striped nightcap with a pom-pom, big sleepy half-closed eyes, a small beak and a tummy patch. Draw exactly 8 frames in ONE horizontal row, equally spaced, every frame the same size and all on the same invisible ground line, plenty of empty space between frames so no frame touches another. Frames: (1)-(2) sleeping while perched, eyes closed, little Z letters floating up, the cap tilting; (3)-(4) waking up, eyes popping open wide with a small exclamation mark above the head; (5)-(8) GLIDING in flight seen from the side facing left, wings spread wide and flapping slowly, four different wing poses, a big yawn on the last one. Each owl is about 22 percent of the image height. 16-bit Super Nintendo style pixel art, chunky hard square pixels, a clean 1-pixel dark plum outline, flat cel shading with one highlight and one shadow tone, light from the top left, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no text, no labels, no watermark. Solid flat cyan background, nothing else.
